title: French Smoked Black Pudding Namul
description: A French-inspired side dish featuring smoky black pudding namul. A unique and flavorful accompaniment to your meals.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine namul, black pudding, black sesame seeds, chopped chives, gochujang, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and salt.
2. Toss the ingredients together until the namul is evenly coated with the seasonings.
3. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
4. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
5. Before serving, give the namul a good stir and adjust the seasoning if needed.
6. Serve chilled or at room temperature.
